title: Verified code for the solver model: the problem, then code that reproduced its number
request: The owner: do 36.6, the code examples that teach how, each verified, into the solver model's data.
spec: PHASE12_TRAINING_DATA_PLAN.md 36.6: exported pipelines whose holdout number re-computes, dev commits whose tests passed, self-play solutions that passed; each as problem, reasoning, code into m5; every code example re-runs to its recorded number in a clean Python.
plan: Read the owner's reasoning rule and what exists
Test first, then the set builder
Run code-check on every kind and build

decisions.decision: No reasoning on these examples, and a note saying who wrote the code
decisions.why: the owner keeps only a model's own thinking summary and cancelled code-written and teacher reasoning; the engine wrote this code

decisions.decision: Only pipelines that reproduced their recorded number
decisions.why: the plan's check: every code example re-runs to its number in a clean Python

decisions.decision: The question comes from the replica's own problem, never from the README
decisions.why: the README is boilerplate that states the recorded score and names no target or moment

decisions.decision: Start with the engine's exported pipelines
decisions.why: they re-run to a number; dev commits re-run to tests, and self-play already reaches m5 as trajectories

change: dclab_rnd/store/sets/code.py (new), scripts/code_check.py (--keep, problem.json, finish stamp), dclab_rnd/store/conductor.py (the verified_code step), tests/test_store_sets_code.py, PHASE12 status.

findings.defect: A replica's pipeline could be trained on while its self-play solve is sealed
findings.scenario: the regression replica's code in train while the same table's self-play solution sits in m5's sealed set
findings.cause: the code example took its own split group instead of the replica's
findings.fix: the split is the replica's self-play group's, by the stricter of the two split rules

findings.defect: The question was not the problem and gave away the score
findings.scenario: the README names no target, moment or columns and states the recorded number
findings.cause: the user turn was built from the export's README
findings.fix: code-check writes the replica's problem; the question is built from it with no result; a kind without it is left out

findings.defect: A later partial or failed run could empty the set
findings.scenario: a run for one kind, or one with broken pins, became the newest and the set was rewritten from it
findings.cause: the newest folder by name was taken whole
findings.fix: each kind comes from its newest finished run in which it passed, by the run's own finish stamp

findings.defect: A test's store read the owner's real runs
findings.scenario: every store build test with a temporary layout would read the real kept runs
findings.cause: the runs folder was fixed to the repository
findings.fix: a layout other than the real store reads a folder inside itself, or the folder named by DCLAB_CODE_RUNS

findings.defect: keep given as the last argument crashed
findings.cause: the folder name was read past the end of the arguments
findings.fix: a missing folder name is a usage error with exit 2

measurements.name: every engine kind exported as code and re-run in a clean Python
measurements.gate: every code example re-runs to its recorded number in a clean Python
measurements.result: 16 of 16 kinds reproduced their holdout number in Python 3.12.13; 16 verified examples: 4 train, 5 dev, 7 sealed
measurements.against_gate: every example taken reproduced its number; none that failed was taken
limits: one example per kind, from invented replica tables
few train examples, because the split follows the replicas' sealed groups

outcome: The solver model now gets verified code: for each engine kind, the problem as a person states it and a pipeline that reproduced its number in a clean Python, with an honest note that the engine wrote it.
lessons: Training data about a table follows that table's split, whatever path it came by.
A question must state the problem, never its answer or its score.
Take each item from its newest good run, never the newest run whole.
When no model thought, say who wrote it instead of inventing a why.
risks: Only 16 examples, 4 of them in train: small next to m5's trajectories.
Dev commits with diffs and real project exports are not covered yet.
